|sellprice = 5000 |quality = false }} The '''Galaxy Soul''' is an item used to upgrade Galaxy weapons in the [[Forge]]. Weapons forged using Galaxy Souls keep their enchantments and gem upgrades. *Galaxy Souls can be purchased at [[Qi's Walnut Room]] for {{Price|40|gem}} each. *After killing at least 50 [[Monsters#Dangerous Monsters|Dangerous Monsters]] , Galaxy Souls can be purchased from the [[Island Trader]] on the last day of a season for {{Name|Radioactive Bar|10|class=inline}}. *After killing at least 50 [[Monsters#Dangerous Monsters|Dangerous Monsters]] , Galaxy Souls can be dropped by any Dangerous Monster. ** The drop chance ranges from 0.098% to 0.102%, depending on [[Luck]] . **Note that [[Shadow Sniper]]s and [[Putrid Ghost]]s do not count as Dangerous Monsters unless the Mines are at [[The Mines#Difficulty Levels|difficulty level 2]] ("Danger in the Deep" quest ''and'' Shrine of Challenge both active). *Semi-transparent [[Slimes|Big Slimes]] containing a Galaxy Soul can be seen in the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|"Dangerous" Mines]] or [[Skull Cavern#Skull Cavern Invasion|"Dangerous" Skull Cavern]]. The Galaxy Soul is dropped upon killing the Big Slime. ==Forge recipes== :''See also: [[Forge#Infinity Weapons|Forge]]'' The Galaxy Soul is used in the [[Forge]] to upgrade a Galaxy Weapon into an Infinity Weapon. The player must upgrade a Galaxy Weapon 3 times, consuming 3 Galaxy Souls and 60 [[Cinder Shard]]s in total. {{#lst:Forge|infinityweapons}} ==References== See Locations.IslandNorth::getIslandMerchantTradeStock in the game code.
